question: On which specific lunar day and in what context is the rite addressed to the great goddess Kuleśvarī performed?
premises: The addressees are Mahādevī and Kuleśvarī
The time is the eighth day of the dark fortnight
inference: The rite is to be performed in Utakaṭa on the eighth day of the dark fortnight, as addressed to Mahādevī Kuleśvarī.
uncertainties: utakaṭe may refer to a place or a specific ritual posture/state
plain_english: And, O great goddess Kuleśvarī, this is done in Utakaṭa on the eighth day of the dark fortnight.
